0.original: The Resistance has secured yet another outpost, and Dmitar would guide you there.

24.original: Speak with Dmitar at the western plateau.

48.original: A Resistance rank of <hex:022003E80203> is required to proceed with this quest.

49.original: Well come, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. I see you've not been resting on your laurels since last we met.

50.original: We've secured a new outpost, and a barrier was erected over the site not long ago.

51.original: If you would follow me, I'll show you to our newest encampment. We've drawn perilously close to the <hex:021A020203>Dalriada<hex:021A020103> now, so be on your guard.

52.original: We are but a stone's throw from the <hex:021A020203>Dalriada<hex:021A020103>, much to the dismay of the IVth Legion, I would assume.

53.original: That their plans yet remain a mystery is concerning, but Master Garlond is confident in his countermeasures for any aerial assaults they may be plotting.

54.original: Victory is nearly at hand, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, I can feel it!

55.original: There is no telling what manner of magitek weaponry the IVth Legion will employ in their desperation, but I have faith we will prevail in the end.

56.original: The Resistance front line advances, allowing you to participate in new skirmishes and critical engagements.

57.original: The next quest can be accepted by speaking with Bajsaljen after reaching Resistance rank <hex:022003E80203> or higher.
